facets.contract: CapturedControl identifies logical frame chain, current image revision, denv/wind identity, PointId and root custodian; stack-backed capture is legal before heap materialization
facets.anchors: Gambit _kernel.scm:3153-3171; mem.c:4046-4206; Chez c/schsig.c:56-141 and c/alloc.c:866-882
facets.replacement: Register the source slot before any collecting materializer; one descriptor drives stack/heap coordinates and captured-image updates
facets.retirement: Independent handwritten frame-coordinate decoding and unregistered materialization inputs after every consumer migrates
facets.benefit: Keep full multi-shot semantics while sharing eligible captured storage; avoid unnecessary eager whole-chain materialization
facets.cost: Descriptor lifetime, rooted image handle and possible materialization/copy; no immutable-image assumption
facets.refutation: Raw frame/continuation setters bypass revision/root discipline or a structural link is mistaken for an ordinary root

facets.contract: Per-invocation execution view and rooted transfer outlive collecting hooks; a valid issued view is refreshed after intervening image changes; Scheme heap identity is shared
facets.replacement: Prepare/root view, run Scheme winding, revalidate image and native origin, then commit restoration under the current execution grant
facets.retirement: C activation or old cached pointer as implicit replay authority; full continuation consumption as an optimization
facets.benefit: Arbitrary repeated full continuation use; reusable restore path for future delimited segments; one-shot optimization remains optional and separately justified
facets.cost: Per-shot restore work and rooted view retention; image changes can force refresh; no guarantee of zero copying
facets.refutation: Matching version is accepted without authentic issuance/all-writer history, or replay rolls back shared heap effects

facets.contract: Root view covers captured and active frames, denv/winders, prompt tags, pending transfer/views, values and code metadata; scanner updates authoritative slots before reentry reload
facets.anchors: Gambit mem.c:4459-4508; Chez s/mkgc.ss:209-269; Guile libguile/vm.c:713-772
facets.replacement: FrameSpec-derived exact movable roots plus managed frame/denv/prompt stores and remembered writes; preserve source custody until destination registration
facets.retirement: Repeated private interpretations of live slots and unchecked old-to-young stores only after complete writer inventory and adapters
facets.benefit: Enable precise moving/generational collection and conditional mature-image scan skipping; root protocol is shared by backends
facets.cost: Root publication/reload, metadata, barriers and remembered scans; retained roots and promotion reserve affect peak
facets.refutation: Import Guile conservative BDW stack marking as precise moving-GC evidence or infer copying implies generations

facets.contract: Compare dynamic extent identity; exit inner-to-outer, enter outer-to-inner; identical extent runs no hooks; hooks may allocate, throw or capture/reenter
facets.replacement: Keep wind semantics and successor continuations in Scheme; generated C supplies rooted checkpoint/reentry adapters, not a second C winding algorithm
facets.retirement: Ad hoc native cleanup treated as Scheme dynamic-wind; physical permit reuse solely because a logical extent is restored
facets.benefit: Amplify existing Scheme nonlocal control without introducing semantic drift across GC, scheduler and FFI
facets.cost: Required user hooks/effects remain; rooted transfers and fresh physical grants add work
facets.refutation: Compare hook procedure equality instead of extent identity, replay hooks twice after a stale helper return, or refuse a legal Scheme hook continuation

facets.contract: PromptSpec defines tag identity, delimiter cut, handler context, abort/composition and reinstatement policy separately from invocation multiplicity
facets.anchors: Guile libguile/vm.c:1310-1345 and module/ice-9/control.scm:59-78; Sitaram PLDI 1993; Flatt/Yu/Findler/Felleisen ICFP 2007
facets.replacement: Add prompt/partial-segment operations through the same FrameSpec/control/root ABI after full multi-shot baseline qualification
facets.retirement: No existing call/cc or wind path retires merely because a library emulates shift/reset
facets.benefit: Capture only an admitted semantic segment; support composable control/effects without downgrading full continuation capability
facets.cost: Prompt lookup and handler/wind interaction; copied segment and dynamic metadata; escape-only can omit image only when no replay is exposed
facets.refutation: Treat all prompt operators as shift/reset, apply an escape-only object as multi-shot, or silently change full call/cc extent

facets.contract: NativeOrigin identifies a still-live C activation; rooted Scheme frames cannot resurrect it; borrowers end before moving scan and cache reload precedes reentry
facets.anchors: Gambit lib/c_intf.c and ___run callers; Guile libguile/continuations.c:186-213,345-376 and vm.c:1316-1325
facets.replacement: Managed native activation/root/borrow adapters explicitly admit crossing, parking and return; nested calls obtain their own activation
facets.retirement: Marker bit or restored Scheme frame alone as proof of live C origin after complete caller migration
facets.benefit: Admitted blocked native calls surrender GC participation safely while roots and results remain owned
facets.cost: Handles, origin checks, park/reload and retained resources; unknown native users can prevent selected reclamation
facets.refutation: Import Guile thread/barrier restrictions verbatim or promise arbitrary C-stack migration without an origin proof

facets.contract: Scheme generates one FrameSpec/PointId/ControlSpec root and restore description; modern C realizes target layout, not Scheme policy
facets.replacement: Migrate emitter, decoder, collector, restorer, frame reflection and module metadata as one vertical slice
facets.retirement: Duplicated C macro/primitive frame meaning after exact generated/native consumer equivalence and bootstrap
facets.benefit: Gambit semantic information serves GC, native ABI, tooling and future LLVM/MLIR consumers; no second language is required
facets.cost: Schema verification, metadata and affected-closure regeneration; LLVM services do not own Scheme semantics
facets.refutation: Add another descriptor wrapper while old macro interpretations remain authoritative

obligations.scope: finite schedules only: GC/root cuts, wind/reentry, stale permits and repeated availability
obligations.limitation: No payload coherence algebra, unbounded proof, complete Scheme observations or C memory-order proof

obligations.scope: unbounded slot maps and finite writer histories under authentic issuance and version match
obligations.limitation: No scheduler, GC interleaving, winding or C proof; version equality alone is insufficient

obligations.scope: QNT abstracts payload as a ticket; source adapter must issue a real coherent view and map mutation revocation to ImageHistory
obligations.limitation: OPEN; a shared field name or two successful tools does not establish this correspondence

obligations.scope: Actual frame/continuation/denv setters, GC repair, restoration, serializer and FFI stores obey publication and remembered-root policy
obligations.limitation: OPEN; selected real setters are identified, not every indirect/native writer closed

obligations.scope: Preserve arbitrary Scheme hooks, returning/abandoned transfers and fresh physical authorization on reinstatement
obligations.limitation: OPEN; bounded takeover histories do not prove arbitrary hook-continuation restoration

obligations.scope: Specify actual operator family and its joint call/cc, dynamic-wind, dynamic binding and exception observations
obligations.limitation: OPEN; QNT only qualifies matching-tag/escape/borrow admission, not production prompt semantics

obligations.scope: Complete bootstrap and all affected control/root/FFI caller paths, exact Bazel profile and unchanged limits
obligations.limitation: OPEN; previous wide-root receipts are baseline evidence, not new prompt/alias/foreign qualification

obligations.scope: Emitter, stack/heap materializer, scanner, ordinary/link partition, reflector, restorer and module metadata share FrameSpec
obligations.limitation: OPEN; source-address, layout and lifetime refinement required

edges.contract: Registered captured image and denv/wind roots
Relocated authoritative slots and root reload
Rooted Scheme transfer; hooks may collect or reenter
Post-hook image refresh and current grant before commit

responsibilities.owns: Transition ordering, concurrent interleavings and permit/task/root lifetime protocols within declared bounds
responsibilities.excludes: Payload algebra, unbounded data-coherence proofs and claims of concrete native correctness

responsibilities.owns: General mathematical/data representation properties under explicit hypotheses
responsibilities.excludes: A duplicate scheduler, bounded trace tests, wind interleavings and claims that premises automatically hold in C

responsibilities.owns: Actual source writers/consumers, semantic correspondence and refinement of imported premises
responsibilities.excludes: Declaring an unresolved native/refinement obligation proved by source-token presence or LLM judgment alone

responsibilities.owns: Source/profile-bound execution, semantic regression, progress and measured resource/performance acceptance
responsibilities.excludes: Promotion of finite models, conditional laws or historical binaries to new native completion
